launchStart.text: Launch sequence started. Destination: the lunar south pole.

leftAtmosphere.text: We've cleared the atmosphere. Heading for the Moon.

lunarApproach.text: Approaching the Moon. Preparing for orbital insertion.

siteCriteria.text: I'm comparing each site on two things: how many hours of sunlight its panels receive, and how many hours it has Earth in view for a direct-to-Earth link. The real terrain at the pole decides both.

welcome.text: Welcome to TOUCHDOWN. I'm Burrito, your space donkey guide. Let's choose where and when to land at the Moon's south pole.
